_description: Decoding and provider settings used for the base runs reported in the paper (Supplementary Section R). Each entry gives the flags for scripts/run_cusp.py. 'cutoff' is the knowledge cutoff (YYYY-MM) used to split events and, for the ws_cutoff condition, as --ws-cutoff. 'access' is 'api' (proprietary API key needed) or 'open-weight' (can run locally).

llama-3.3-70b.notes: Serve the checkpoint behind any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. vLLM) and set OPENAI_API_BASE; the original-corpus run used local Hugging Face Transformers through scripts/test_LLM.py --model_path.

gpt-oss-20b.notes: Serve locally behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (vLLM) and set OPENAI_API_BASE; the original-corpus run used local Hugging Face Transformers through scripts/test_LLM.py --model_path.

deepseek-r1.notes: The paper's run used an Azure AI Foundry deployment that has since been retired. The open weights can be served behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (provider OPENAI with OPENAI_API_BASE).

gpt-5.4.notes: Reasoning model: when --effort is set, no temperature is sent.

claude-sonnet-5.notes: The API rejects temperature/top_p/top_k for this model; it runs at its default sampling with adaptive thinking.

claude-opus-4.8.notes: The API rejects temperature/top_p/top_k for this model; it runs at its default sampling with adaptive thinking.

gpt-5.6-sol.notes: Only the default temperature is accepted; runs with reasoning effort medium.
